topic: A person's invention is already patented by someone else
text: I was working tirelessly, pouring my heart and soul into this project, convinced I was on the brink of something revolutionary. Then, I get this news. Slapped in the face with a patent document that shows all my hard work, my supposedly "groundbreaking" idea, was filed and approved months ago. Some guy, or maybe a team of them, with more resources and reach, got there first. My ideas, my sweat, and every late night—what do they mean, "already in use"? Now, I'm left with nothing but a bitter taste and a pile of sketches that might as well be kindling for a fire. Great. Just great.
